title: Annular structure forced by recurrent transverse-path accumulation (Proposition 3.3)
author: Pierre-Antoine Guihéneuf; Patrice Le Calvez; Alejandro Passeggi
work: Area preserving homeomorphisms of surfaces with rational rotational direction
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue8 (2025),329–372; official AHL_2025__8__329_0.tex processed2025-04-16
difficulty_reason: H2: the full independent proposition proves a global annular rigidity configuration from recurrent transverse-path accumulation, through local foliation-chart graph arguments, control of competing deck translates, return configurations and a one-sided-access obstruction. This is the authors strengthened geometric result, not the routine four-way endpoint alternative and not a corollary of the later periodic-orbit theorem.
